evals.prompt: Our app feels sluggish: dropdowns use ease-in, toasts jump with keyframes, and tab switches animate for 600ms. Audit the motion and tell me what to fix first.
evals.expected_output: Should survey the motion code read-only, produce a prioritized audit (ease-in dropdowns first as highest leverage), and write self-contained plans with exact values under plans/ — without modifying source.
assertions: Surveys motion code without modifying any source file
Produces a prioritized audit with highest-leverage item first
Flags ease-in on dropdowns as a problem
Writes plans under plans/ (or animation-plans/) only
Plans inline exact values (cubic-bezier, durations, file paths) with zero assumed context

evals.prompt: Just fix the toast animation directly, it jumps when it appears.
evals.expected_output: Should decline to fix it directly, cite the read-only rule, and point to executing the written plan with any agent instead.
assertions: Declines to modify source code directly
Points to plan execution (improve-animations execute or any agent running the plan)
Still delivers the audit finding and plan for the toast

evals.prompt: Audit keyboard-triggered animations in our command palette: Escape closes with a 400ms fade, arrow navigation animates each move.
evals.expected_output: Should flag animating keyboard navigation moves and the slow Escape fade as findings, since keyboard actions should feel instant and never carry staged animation.
assertions: Flags animated arrow-key navigation as a problem
Flags the slow Escape-close fade as a problem
States that keyboard actions should feel instant
Writes a self-contained plan with exact replacement values and file paths
